## Experience

## Projects

- [mini-redis](https://www.paritoshsingh.me/projects/mini-redis): Redis-compatible server in 594 lines of C++ on a single-threaded, non-blocking epoll event loop over raw POSIX sockets. 150K+ SET/GET per second across 50 clients on one core; 2.7M+ GET and 2.4M+ SET per second at 128-deep pipelining; 18 commands including pub/sub.
- [Revenant](https://www.paritoshsingh.me/projects/revenant): AI payment-recovery agent (Razorpay AI Buildathon 2026) that measures causal lift with a stratified 50/50 randomised holdout and bootstrap intervals; 93.8% coverage of a known true lift over 2,000 runs; hash-chained, append-only audit log in PostgreSQL. Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Playwright.
- [Agent Replay](https://www.paritoshsingh.me/projects/agent-replay): behavioural contracts and CI for AI agents (WeMakeDevs × AWS hackathon). Derives a YAML contract of required tool calls from 5 recorded runs and fails CI on the exact diverging step using set logic, not an LLM judge. AWS Bedrock, Strands Agents, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, GitHub Actions with OIDC, 339 pytest tests.
- [Vigil](https://www.paritoshsingh.me/projects/vigil): multi-hazard disaster prediction for 7 hazard types across 25 Indian cities with XGBoost and LightGBM ensembles and SHAP explanations; ROC AUC 0.74 to 0.88. Research paper accepted in ISJEM.
- [TeamPulse](https://www.paritoshsingh.me/projects/teampulse): real-time, Slack-style collaboration platform with WebRTC calls, 73 REST endpoints, 15 Socket.IO handlers, RBAC, JWT and Google OAuth, and a Bull + Redis job queue.
